users.title: Users
users.search: Search by name, phone or email
users.emptyBody: People who ask to join your institution appear here for approval.

user.title: Person
user.outranks: This person has more access than you. You can see their details but not change them.
user.name: Name
user.emailHelp: The new email works for signing in at once.
user.sharedProfile: This person also belongs to another institution, so only they can change their name, phone or email.
user.approveBody: They can sign in and use the app with the roles you give them.
user.deactivateBody: They are signed out of this institution at once and cannot use it until reactivated. Their records stay.
user.reason: Reason (optional, kept in the change log)
user.reactivateBody: They can use the institution again with the roles they still have.
user.noRoles: No role yet. Without a role this person can sign in but sees nothing.
user.removeBody: Their access changes on their next action.
user.explainLink: Why can or can't they see a record?

assign.title: Give a role
assign.previewHelp: What this role adds for this person, with its limits.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Built-in roles come from your institution's template. Create your own by starting from one of them.
roles.name: Name

role.title: Role
role.name: Name
role.nameHelp: Leave empty on a built-in role to keep its standard name.
role.flagsHelp: How people with this role are treated in lists, reports and escalations.
role.superAdmin: The Super Admin role always has every permission, including sensitive ones. It cannot be changed.
role.sensitiveNote: Adding or removing a sensitive permission needs two-step sign-in.
role.copyNote: Sensitive permissions are not copied; add them yourself.
role.deleteBody: People who have this role move to the role you choose below.

help.own: Only records they own or created.
help.team: Records of the teams they manage.
help.org_unit: Records of their unit and the units below it.
help.branch: Records of their $t(labels:branch.singular) (or the one set on the role).
help.all: All records, within any limit set on the role.

modules.title: Modules
modules.intro: Turn on the parts your institution uses. A module that is off disappears from menus, Home, filters and reports; its data is kept and comes back when you turn it on again.
modules.onBody: It appears in menus and settings for everyone with access.
modules.offBody: It disappears from menus, Home and reports, and its background jobs stop. Nothing is deleted.

compare.title: Compare two roles
compare.noDifference: These two roles give the same permissions.

newPermissions.title: New permissions in {{release}}
newPermissions.intro: New permissions are given to built-in roles by their template, and to your own roles that start from them — never when the permission is sensitive. Check that this is what you want.
newPermissions.givenToNone: Not given to any role yet

explain.title: Why can or can't someone see a record?
explain.intro: Pick a person and a record. The answer shows each of their roles and what allows or blocks the record.
explain.creator: Created by

summary.allowed: At least one role allows it.
summary.membership_inactive: This person is not active in your institution.
summary.no_role_grants: None of their roles gives this permission.
summary.blocked_by_limits: A role gives the permission, but its limits leave this record out.

rules.creator: They created the record, so they can still see it.
rules.scope_own: Covers their own records, and this is one.
rules.scope_team: Covers their team's records, and this is one.
rules.scope_org_unit: Covers their unit's records, and this is one.
rules.scope_branch: Covers their $t(labels:branch.singular)'s records, and this is one.
rules.no_permission: This role does not give the permission.
rules.not_built: Access is being updated. Try again in a minute.
rules.no_branch_on_record: The record has no $t(labels:branch.singular); only its creator can see it under this limit.
rules.owner_scope: Covers only some people's records ({{scope}}); this record belongs to someone else.
rules.no_offering_on_record: The record has no $t(labels:offering.singular); only its creator can see it under this limit.

explain.noRecordTypes: Record types such as $t(labels:lead.plural) can be picked once they exist; until then, describe a record.

branches.title: $t(labels:branch.plural)
branches.intro: Each $t(labels:branch.singular) has its own address, phone and head.
branches.offBody: Your institution works as one place. Ask the platform to turn on $t(labels:branch.plural) when you open another one.
branches.name: Name
branches.head: Head of the $t(labels:branch.singular)
branches.archiveBody: It disappears from lists. Its history stays.
branches.moveBody: These still use this $t(labels:branch.singular). Choose where they go; then it is archived.
branches.headLine: Head: {{name}}

terms.title: Words used in this institution
terms.intro: Rename a word and every screen uses it at once, in English and Bangla. Receipts and messages use the same words — check the preview.
terms.search: Search words (current, default or old name)
terms.resetAllTitle: Reset all words to the defaults?
terms.resetAllBody: Every renamed word goes back to its default. Words locked by the platform stay.
terms.lockedBody: This word is set by the platform and cannot be changed here.
terms.bnMore: Other Bangla forms (filled in for you; change if needed)
terms.saved: Word saved — every screen now uses it

preview.title: Preview
preview.name: Rahim Uddin
preview.smsText: Dear Rahim, thank you for your interest. Your $t(labels:lead.singular) number is {{number}}. Our $t(labels:caller.singular) will call you soon. — {{institution}}

types.title: Institution type
types.intro: The types of your institution decide its starting words, stages, documents, fees, roles and settings. You can add or remove a type at any time: you see a preview first, nothing is deleted and your own changes stay.
types.chooseHelp: A mixed institution (for example school and college) chooses more than one.
types.warning: Nothing is deleted. Words and settings you changed yourself stay as they are. Parts used later are stored now.
types.conflict: Two types use different words for "{{key}}". Choose one:
types.applyBody: The preview above is applied. Nothing is deleted and your own changes stay.
types.resetHelp: Undo your own changes in one area and go back to the defaults of your types.
types.resetNone: You have not changed anything yet.
types.resetSheetHelp: These go back to the default (now → after):

areas.blocks: Later parts (test, merit list, board, hostel)

plan.title: Plan and usage
plan.howToUpgrade: To change the plan, contact your account manager.

limits.tellAdmin: Tell your Admin: they can upgrade the plan.

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.intro: Your own fields for each record. Group and order them; retire a field you no longer need (its answers are kept).
fields.keyHelp: Used by exports and the API; fixed once the field has answers.
fields.typeLocked: The type is fixed once the field has answers.
fields.choicesHelp: One per line: key | English | বাংলা
fields.retired: Field retired; its answers are kept

flagHelp.show_on_card: A line on the record's card.
flagHelp.show_in_list: A column in lists and tables.
flagHelp.filterable: Adds a fast filter (counts towards speed; use for the fields people filter on).
flagHelp.include_in_export: A column in Excel / CSV exports.
flagHelp.show_on_public_form: Asked on the institution's public form.
flagHelp.sensitive: Only people with the permission see it; never sent to AI.

exports.title: Full export
exports.help: All your institution's data in one file (also while read only). Keep it safe: it holds personal data.
exports.webOnly: Open the web app to download the file.

lifecycle.pending: Your institution is waiting for approval. You can keep setting it up.
lifecycle.readOnly: Read only: you can see and export everything but not change it. Tell your Admin.

supportLog.title: Support access
supportLog.intro: Every time platform staff entered your institution: who, when, why, for how long, and what they did.
supportLog.empty: Nobody from the platform has entered your institution.

checklist.title: Setup checklist
checklist.intro: What is left before you are fully set up, and who does it.
checklist.complete: Everything available now is set up.
checklist.merchantNote: Online payment needs your own merchant account; you can take payments by hand until then.

branding.title: Branding
branding.help: Short name, logo and colour shown after sign-in.

offerings.title: $t(labels:offering.plural), $t(labels:cohort.plural) and $t(labels:slot_group.plural)
offerings.help: What you offer and how it is grouped.

pipeline_words.title: Pipeline and words
pipeline_words.help: Check the pipeline steps and the words used in the app (Settings → Terminology).

staff.title: Invite your team
staff.help: Add people and give them roles.

messaging.title: SMS and email
messaging.help: The platform connects your SMS and email accounts.

payment_merchant.title: Online payment
payment_merchant.help: Open your own SSLCommerz merchant account (trade licence, bank account, verification); the platform then enters its details. Manual payment works meanwhile.

message_templates.title: Message templates
message_templates.help: Write your own SMS and email texts.

application_form.title: Public application form
application_form.help: A form on your website or a link.

own_domain.title: Your own web address
own_domain.help: Optional: the app on your own domain.

ai_drive.title: AI key and Google Drive
ai_drive.help: Optional: bring your own AI key and Google Drive.

lead_import.title: Import old $t(labels:lead.plural)
lead_import.help: Bring your existing list in from Excel.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Your name, logo and colour, shown to your team after sign-in.
branding.name: Institution name
branding.shortHelp: Up to 40 characters; shown where space is short.
branding.noLogo: No logo yet: your short name is shown.
branding.logoHelp: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1 MB; square works best.
branding.logoOnWeb: Upload the logo from the web app; the phone app gets this with its next version.
branding.logoTooBig: The logo is larger than 1 MB.
branding.contrastOk: Readable in light and dark mode.
branding.contrastAccent: Not enough contrast for buttons: it is used as an accent colour only.
branding.signInNeutral: The sign-in page always shows the app's own name, not yours.
branding.readOnly: You can see the branding but not change it.
